profile.name: Anupam Das
profile.position: Research Assistant at Viral genomic and Infection Dynamics Laboratory
profile.institution: Department of Microbiology and Hygiene, Bangladesh Agricultural University (BAU)
profile.bio: My research interests lie at the intersection of molecular virology, viral genomics, and pathogen evolution, with a focus on understanding viral diversity and host–virus interactions. I seek to develop this foundation through doctoral research on the molecular biology and evolution of viral pathogens.
profile.researchInterests: My PhD research interests center on the molecular evolution and phylodynamics of avian and zoonotic RNA/DNA viruses — particularly reassortment, recombination, and selection pressure driving emergence in poultry-dense, high-spillover-risk regions like South Asia. I am seeking a PhD lab with strengths in viral genomics, computational evolutionary biology, and One Health surveillance, where field-derived data can be paired with rigorous bioinformatic modeling.
profile.researchPhilosophy: I approach a problem by first going to the source — the outbreak, the sample, the raw sequencing read — before trusting any downstream model. Field diagnostics taught me that clean data beats clever statistics, and computational virology taught me that a phylogeny is only as honest as the quality control behind it. I try to hold both instincts at once: hands willing to do the bench work, and a mind that stays skeptical of its own pipeline.

education.description: Thesis: Molecular detection and complete genomic characterization of fowl adenovirus (FAdV) strains circulating in poultry in Bangladesh.
Registered Veterinarian (BVC Reg No: 9682). 5-year professional veterinary program covering infectious disease pathology, epidemiology, clinical diagnostics, and diagnostic internship.

category1.title: In Vitro & Wet-Lab
category1.subtitle: Diagnostic Benchwork & Viral Culture
bullets: Viral Isolation & Culture: Embryonated Chicken Egg (ECE) inoculation (amniotic, allantoic, CAM routes), primary cell culture maintenance, cytopathic effect (CPE) monitoring.
Serology & Titration: Hemagglutination (HA) and HA Inhibition (HI) assays, viral infectivity titration (EID50, ELD50 calculations), indirect and sandwich ELISA assays.
Molecular Assays: Viral DNA/RNA extraction,  PCR, Reverse transcriptas-PCR, Real time PCR,  agarose gel electrophoresis, gel documentation.
Biosafety & Sample Processing: BSL-2 laboratory procedures, field sample processing from poultry/livestock tissue, aseptic technique, cold-chain maintenance.

category2.title: Computational & Viral Bioinformatics
category2.subtitle: NGS Analysis & Evolutionary Modeling
bullets: NGS Genome Assembly & Annotation: Full-length viral genome assembly (SPAdes, MEGAHIT), quality filtering (FastQC, Trimmomatic), gene prediction, genome annotation (Prokka, NCBI).
Phylogenetics & Evolutionary Dynamics: Maximum Likelihood and Bayesian phylogenetic tree construction (IQ-TREE, MEGA, BEAST), tree visualization (FigTree, iTOL).
Recombination & Selection Pressure: Recombination detection suite (RDP4/RDP5), site-specific selection pressure analysis (PAML).
Vaccinology & Computational Tools: Subtractive genomics, Linux shell scripting, Python & R data visualization.
